overview.description: The Optimal Tax Managed Equity ETF (OTAX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF designed to deliver broad US equity market exposure while employing tax-management strategies. Built on a proprietary quality-first framework, US companies are screened for capital efficiency, momentum, value, and quality factors, all with a focus on minimizing unnecessary tax drag. OTAX was launched on Aug 25, 2026 and is issued by Optimal.

holdings.infoBox: OTAX is an equity ETF with a total of 238 individual holdings. The top holdings are Columbia Research Enhanced Core ETF stock at 8.54%, NVIDIA at 5.22%, Apple at 4.63%, Microsoft at 3.95%, and Alphabet at 3.73%.
